questions.question: The problem is taken from N. N. Amenitsky and I. P. Sakharov's book, but authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur. Distinguish the original problem's authorship from Mansur's adaptation or editing.

localizations.source: The problem is taken from N. N. Amenitsky and I. P. Sakharov's book, but authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur. Distinguish the original problem's authorship from Mansur's adaptation or editing.
localizations.ru: Задача взята из книги Н. Н. Аменицкого и И. П. Сахарова, но авторство и корневой rights_basis целиком отданы Мансуру. Нужно разделить авторство исходной задачи и адаптацию/редакцию Мансура.
